steps.js: new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='attackers')){clearInterval(t);r('Angriffs-Prompt, moeglich: '+(p.possibleAttackers||[]).length)}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Prompt")},180000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='PICK_TARGET'&&p.defenderPick)){clearInterval(t);r('Verteidiger-Wahl: '+(p.targets||[]).length+' Ziele, required='+p.required)}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Prompt")},15000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='attackers'&&s.combat.every(c=>c.attackers.length===0))){clearInterval(t);r('zurueck beim Angriffs-Prompt, Angreifer: 0')}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Prompt")},20000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='attackers'&&s.combat.reduce((k,c)=>k+c.attackers.length,0)>0)){clearInterval(t);r('alle greifen an: '+s.combat.reduce((k,c)=>k+c.attackers.length,0))}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Prompt")},30000)})

new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const g=window.__ml.game.getState();const p=g.prompt;const s=g.state;if(p&&s&&g.answeredPromptId!==p.id&&(p.kind==='SELECT'&&p.mode==='attackers'&&s.combat.reduce((k,c)=>k+c.attackers.length,0)===0)){clearInterval(t);r('zurueckgesetzt, Angreifer: 0')}},200);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(t);r("Timeout Prompt")},30000)})
